title: CVE-assignment gap in self-hosted-AI security advisories
author: MV2 of Munim, Inc.
source: each repo's GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/security-advisories?state=published, captured by the advisory-verify compute job
method: counts code-extracted (ripgrep / cve_assignment_gap.py) from the job's raw advisories.json; no WebFetch summaries
notes: by_repo gives per-repo advisory totals; run cve_assignment_gap.py on advisories.json to also get the no-CVE split per repo.
'no CVE id in the GHSA record' is point-in-time; a CVE can be assigned later.
Severity is the GitHub advisory severity as published by each repo.
